--SCRIPTS AND MODELS CREATED BY @EthererElsie (Feel free to credit if this system was helpful :3)
--HERE'S A TUTORIAL ON HOW TO USE THE MOVING PLATFORM SYSTEM AND WHAT EACH VALUE DOES!!!

--Simply there are two parts in the model called Start and Finish, you can move these around as you please, and set the starting positions and ending positions! (P.S, Don't worry about removing the billboardguis or attachments from the parts, they automatically remove themselves once the game starts running, they're simply there to give you a good idea for what it may look like!)
--IF you have a Custom Platform Model you want to use for the platform, simply put it in the PlatformModel folder inside the model, ungroup the your model (if it's grouped), and rename the center part of the model to "Handle" in order for it to work!

--WHAT EACH ATTRIBUTE DOES:
--Now select the MovingPlatform model and open the properties tab and scroll down to the attributes section, the attributes control how the moving platform works!!

--Active - Boolean: The active attribute simply states whether or not the platform is moving or not, if this value is set to true, the platform will move, if it's set to false, it will not move (Setting it to false while the platform is moving will cause it to pause at it's current position unless ResetWhenDeactivated is set to true)
--AlignCFrame - Boolean: This attribute determines if the moving platform's Position and Orientation should align with the Start and End goal CFrames/Orientations
--Delay - Number: Whenever the platform reaches it's certain end and start goals, this value will control how long the platform stops once it reaches it's goal before it continues to move again.
--Direction - String: The Tween Direction of the Platform (Must be set to 'In', 'Out', or 'InOut' or else it won't work) For more info on Tween Directions, visit here: https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/enums/EasingDirection
--GoalReached - Boolean: A value that simply tells you if the platform has hit the end goal, if the Platform is looped, it will swap between these values as it moves back and fourth between the start and end position, if this value is set to true before starting the game, the platform will automatically start at the ending position instead of the starting position
--Length - Number: Simply the amount of time in seconds it takes for the platform to reach it's goal
--MovementType - String: This value makes up how the platform should move, if this value is set to 'Loop' it will always move back and fourth between the start and end position, if it's set to 'LoopOnce' then the platform will move back and fourth between the start and the end position once then it will stop, or if it's set to 'Once' then the platform will move to the end position or start position then completely stop until it is set to active again.
--ResetWhenDeactivated - Boolean: This value determines whether or not the platform will pause at it's current position when it's deactivated or if it resets back to it's starting position when deactivated
--Stick - Boolean: This value simply determines whether or not a player can stick to the platform
--Style - String: The Tween Style of the Platform (Must be set to 'Linear', 'Sine', 'Back', 'Quad', 'Quart', 'Quint', 'Bounce', 'Elastic', 'Exponential', 'Circular', or 'Cubic' or else it won't work) For more info on Tween Styles, visit here: https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/enums/EasingStyle


--AND THAT'S IT!! Hopefully this helps people out!!
script:Destroy()

local ts = game:GetService("TweenService")
local physics = game:GetService("PhysicsService")
local info = TweenInfo.new
local insert = table.insert

physics:RegisterCollisionGroup("MovingPlatforms")

function getEnum(name, enum)
	for _, v in enum:GetEnumItems() do
		if v.Name == name then
			return v
		end
	end
end

function weldModel(model : Model, canStick : boolean)
	local handle = model:WaitForChild("Handle")
	handle.Anchored = true
	
	for _, v in model:GetDescendants() do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") then
			v.CanCollide = true
			v.CanTouch = true
			v.CollisionGroup = "MovingPlatforms"
			if canStick then
				v:AddTag("___Stick")
			end
			if v ~= handle then
				local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint", v)
				weld.Part0 = v
				weld.Part1 = handle
				weld.Enabled = true
				v.Anchored = false
			end
		end
	end
	
	return handle
end

function checkCFrame(align : boolean, frame : CFrame)
	if align then
		return frame
	else
		return CFrame.new(frame.Position)
	end
end

function setup(platformFolder : Model)
	local platform = platformFolder:WaitForChild("PlatformModel")
	local start, finish = platformFolder:WaitForChild("Start"), platformFolder:WaitForChild("Finish")
	
	local atts = platformFolder:GetAttributes()
	
	local handle = weldModel(platform, atts["Stick"])
	
	local functionsList = {}
	
	insert(functionsList, platformFolder.AttributeChanged:Connect(function()
		atts = platformFolder:GetAttributes()
	end))
	
	if atts["GoalReached"] then
		handle.CFrame = checkCFrame(atts["AlignCFrame"], finish.CFrame)
	else
		handle.CFrame = checkCFrame(atts["AlignCFrame"], start.CFrame)
	end
	
	local goals = {
		goalEnd = {},
		goalStart = {},
		goalReset = {}
	}
	
	goals.goalStart.CFrame = checkCFrame(atts["AlignCFrame"], start.CFrame)
	goals.goalEnd.CFrame = checkCFrame(atts["AlignCFrame"], finish.CFrame)
	goals.goalReset.CFrame = checkCFrame(atts["AlignCFrame"], handle.CFrame)
	
	local tweenFo = info(atts["Length"], getEnum(atts["Style"], Enum.EasingStyle), getEnum(atts["Direction"], Enum.EasingDirection), 0, false, atts["Delay"])
	
	local tweenEnd, tweenStart = ts:Create(handle, tweenFo, goals.goalEnd), ts:Create(handle, tweenFo, goals.goalStart)
	local tweenReset = ts:Create(handle, info(.25), goals.goalReset)
	
	local resetValue = atts["GoalReached"]
	local reset = false
	local looped = true
	
	local debounce = false
	
	local playingStart, playingFinish = false, false
	
	insert(functionsList, platformFolder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Active"):Connect(function()
		if platformFolder:GetAttribute("Active") then
			if atts["GoalReached"] then
				tweenStart:Play()
			else
				tweenEnd:Play()
			end
			reset = false
		else
			if atts["ResetWhenDeactivated"] then
				reset = true
				looped = true
				tweenReset:Play()
				platformFolder:SetAttribute("GoalReached", resetValue)
			else
				if atts["GoalReached"] then
					tweenStart:Pause()
				else
					tweenEnd:Pause()
				end
			end
		end
	end))
	
	insert(functionsList, tweenStart:GetPropertyChangedSignal("PlaybackState"):Connect(function()
		if tweenStart.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Playing and not playingStart then
			playingStart = true
			tweenStart.Completed:Wait()
			if not reset then
				if atts["MovementType"] == "Loop" then
					looped = not looped
					tweenEnd:Play()
				elseif atts["MovementType"] == "LoopOnce" then
					looped = not looped
					if not looped then
						tweenEnd:Play()
					else
						platformFolder:SetAttribute("Active", false)
					end
				elseif atts["MovementType"] == "Once" then
					platform:SetAttribute("Active", false)
				end

				platformFolder:SetAttribute("GoalReached", false)
			end
			playingStart = false
		end
	end))
	
	insert(functionsList, tweenEnd:GetPropertyChangedSignal("PlaybackState"):Connect(function()
		if tweenEnd.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Playing and not playingFinish then
			playingFinish = true
			tweenEnd.Completed:Wait()
			if not reset then
				if atts["MovementType"] == "Loop" then
					looped = not looped
					tweenStart:Play()
				elseif atts["MovementType"] == "LoopOnce" then
					looped = not looped
					if not looped then
						tweenStart:Play()
					else
						platformFolder:SetAttribute("Active", false)
					end
				elseif atts["MovementType"] == "Once" then
					platform:SetAttribute("Active", false)
				end

				platformFolder:SetAttribute("GoalReached", true)
			end
			playingFinish = false
		end
	end))
	
	if atts["Active"] then
		if atts["GoalReached"] then
			tweenStart:Play()
		else
			tweenEnd:Play()
		end
	end
	
	start:Destroy()
	finish:Destroy()
	
	insert(functionsList, platformFolder.Destroying:Connect(function()
		for _, func in pairs(functionsList) do
			func:Disconnect()
		end
		tweenStart:Destroy()
		tweenEnd:Destroy()
	end))
end

function check(v)
	if v:IsA("Model") then
		if v:HasTag("MovingPlatform") then
			setup(v)
		end
	end
end

workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(check)

for _, v in workspace:GetDescendants() do
	check(v)
end

local Char = script.Parent
local Hum = Char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

local RunS = game:GetService("RunService")

local Params = RaycastParams.new()
Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Char}
Params.CollisionGroup = "MovingPlatforms"
Params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

local runFun, diedFun, LastPlatform, LastPlatformCF, Delta, Platform, ray, Raycast, Hit, currentState

local RootAttach = Char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local find = table.find

local StateList = {
	"Jumping",
	"FallingDown",
	"Freefall",
	"Landed",
	"Physics"
}

runFun = RunS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if Char and Hum then
		currentState = Hum:GetState()
		if Hum.RootPart and currentState then
			if find(StateList, currentState.Name) then
				return
			end
			
			ray = Vector3.new(0,(-Char:GetExtentsSize().Y/2)-.1,0)

			Raycast = workspace:Raycast(RootAttach.CFrame.Position,ray, Params)
			Hit = nil
			
			if Raycast then
				Hit = Raycast.Instance
			end
			
			if Hit then
				if Hit:HasTag("___Stick") then

					Platform = Hit
					
					if LastPlatformCF ~= nil and LastPlatform == Platform then
						Delta = Platform.CFrame * LastPlatformCF:inverse()
						Delta -= Vector3.new(0, Delta.Position.Y, 0)
						RootAttach.CFrame = Delta*RootAttach.CFrame
					end
					
					LastPlatform = Platform
					LastPlatformCF = Platform.CFrame
					
					return
				end
			end
			
			LastPlatformCF = nil
			LastPlatform = nil
		end
	end
end)

diedFun = Hum.Died:Connect(function()
	runFun:Disconnect()
	diedFun:Disconnect()
	script:Destroy()
end)
